fields.name: boot_disk
fields.description: Omit for a 40 GiB SSD OS disk.

fields.name: block_size
fields.description: YC physical block size in bytes (4096..131072 powers of two); omitted selects the smallest size that fits the disk. AWS does not expose this setting.
fields.title: Physical block size

fields.name: gb
fields.description: OS disk size in GiB; must fit the selected image.
fields.title: Size
Boot disk

fields.name: core_fraction
fields.description: YC guaranteed CPU percentage; omission means 100. Unsupported on AWS.
fields.title: Guaranteed CPU

fields.name: preemptible
fields.description: Override the provider profile's preemptible/spot setting; explicit false is preserved.
fields.title: Preemptible

fields.name: public_ip
fields.description: Override public addressing for this VM; outbound connectivity remains required for the agent and image pulls.
fields.title: Public IP

fields.name: disks
fields.description: Secondary disks beyond the boot disk.

fields.name: block_size
fields.description: YC physical block size in bytes (4096..131072 powers of two); omitted selects the smallest size that fits the disk. AWS does not expose this setting.
fields.title: Physical block size

fields.name: type
fields.description: Provider disk type id, e.g. network-ssd (yandex) or gp3 (aws).
fields.title: Disk type

fields.name: filesystem
fields.description: Automatic filesystem for mounted YC disks; omit for ext4. No mount means a raw block device.
fields.title: Filesystem

fields.name: mount_options
fields.description: mount/fstab options, e.g. noatime; omission uses defaults.
fields.title: Mount options

fields.name: mount
fields.description: Absolute path host_prep mounts the disk at; empty leaves it raw.
fields.title: Mount point
Extra disks

fields.name: image
fields.description: Resolved boot image (family id, image id or AMI id).
fields.title: Image

fields.name: location
fields.description: Zone (yandex) or availability zone (aws) the machine is created in.
fields.title: Location

fields.name: instance_type
fields.description: Platform id (yandex) or EC2 instance type (aws) from the size table.
fields.title: Instance type

fields.name: labels
fields.description: Provider labels; the run and role labels are added by the pipeline.
fields.title: Labels
